access_boundary: This record represents the GPT-4o release whose API page lists gpt-4o-2024-08-06 as the default snapshot behind the gpt-4o alias alongside the gpt-4o-2024-05-13 and gpt-4o-2024-11-20 snapshots; OpenAI's deprecation page lists gpt-4o-2024-05-13 for shutdown on 2026-10-23. ChatGPT, gpt-4o-mini, audio and realtime variants, fine-tuned derivatives, and later GPT releases are separate boundaries.
strengths: OpenAI documents three dated snapshots and the alias default, so applications can pin a specific revision
The deprecation page records announcement and shutdown dates per snapshot rather than per alias
tradeoffs: No developer-published weights are available for self-operation or independent deployment
The earliest snapshot is already scheduled for shutdown, and movement of the alias between snapshots is controlled by the managed service

evidence.label: Official GPT-4o model, snapshot, modality, and endpoint documentation

flags.statement: After reviewing the results from the Preparedness evaluations, the Safety Advisory Group recommended classifying GPT‑4o before mitigations as borderline medium risk for persuasion, and low risk in all others.
